prompt: The video begins with a steady forward movement up a stone staircase surrounded by lush greenery, leading towards a clearing under a bright, sunny sky. The camera maintains a first-person perspective, capturing the natural light filtering through the dense foliage, casting dynamic shadows on the path. As the ascent continues, the surrounding environment reveals large rocks and trees, enhancing the serene, untouched atmosphere of Fushimi Inari Taisha in Kyoto, Japan. The camera angle remains consistent, focusing straight ahead as it approaches a vibrant red torii gate, marking the entrance to a sacred area. Upon reaching the top of the stairs, the scene transitions to an open courtyard bordered by traditional wooden fences and a two-story building with a dark roof, nestled amidst the forested landscape. The sunlight illuminates the entire area, highlighting the rich colors of the torii and the natural surroundings. The camera then pans slightly to the right, offering a broader view of the tranquil setting, devoid of any people, emphasizing the peaceful solitude of this outdoor-natural scene during the daytime.
